name: Wafer Biscuit
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Cocoa Solids (5%), Dextrose, Edible Starch, Milk Solids, Edible Vegetable Fat, Emulsifier (E322), Edible Common Salt, Raising Agent [E500(ii)], Dough Conditioner [E223]. CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL FOOD COLOUR (E150d) AND ADDED FLAVOURS (ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES - CHOCOLATE, VANILLA)
